name: Self-Supervised Visual Representation Learning
short: Capstone for Yann LeCun’s Fall 2025 Deep Learning course — self-supervised pretraining from 500k unlabeled images.
full: Capstone for Yann LeCun’s Fall 2025 Deep Learning course. From 500k unlabeled images and no pretrained weights: explored DINOv2, hit severe compute limits (4 hrs/epoch), then pivoted to MoCo v3 (ViT-Small, 42.84M params) for a 12× speedup. Ablations across k-NN vs. linear probe, LR sweeps, and training duration led to domain-specific warm-starting on NABirds — CUB-200 36.65% (+27%), Mini-ImageNet 54.58%, SUN397 28.07%.
